draft.strengthQuote: Three-year starter and team captain in 2021.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.69, the 216th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 28th of 37 at CB. He went 172nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (216th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2021) ranked 1st in passes defended among the 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the New York Jets (practice squad). 46 career games and 11 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 4 in 2024. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 11.8% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, below the norm.
